footnote_text: Simultaneously with the closing of the over-allotment option on April 15, 2026 by the underwriters in connection with the Issuers initial public offering, the Sponsor purchased an additional 3,029 private units at $10.00 per private unit, for an aggregate purchase price of $30,290. Each private unit consist of one ordinary share and one right (Right) to receive one-fourth (1/4) of one ordinary share upon consummation of the Issuer's initial business combination. || Mr. Shaoren Liu is the sole member and sole director of Apex Innovation Acquisition Corp. (the -Sponsor-) and has sole voting and investment discretion with respect to the shares held by the Sponsor and may be deemed to beneficially own those shares.
